title: John Trump likely involved in the 1952 Washington wave

tellings.quote: I personally think he would have been involved in, for example, the 1952 wave over DC, which was a very radar-intensive wave.

plain: In 1952 a wave of UFO sightings over Washington, D.C. was, in the words of a researcher who goes by RedPandaKoala, "very radar-intensive," and that researcher believes a man named John G. Trump would have been involved in it. RedPandaKoala tells Michels this as a personal opinion, without a source. If right, it would tie a named figure to the government's handling of the event.
